answer: Only a fixed number of admission slots open per epoch and each applicant must complete a verifiable delay lottery ticket, so entry is rationed by sequential time rather than by money alone. A farm buying a thousand tickets still waits through a thousand sequential delays and wins slots only by lottery odds, while honest agents compete on equal time. The ocean of the design is public, the haven of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the dawn of honest work is what finally pays.
